text_en: To the leader. Of the Korahites. A Maskil.
text_cn: 科辣黑后裔的训诲歌，交与乐官。

text_en: We have heard with our ears, O God, our ancestors have told us, what deeds you performed in their days, in the days of old:
text_cn: 天主，我们亲耳听见过，祖先也给我们述说过： 昔日在他们那一时代，你手所行的伟业。

text_en: you with your own hand drove out the nations, but them you planted; you afflicted the peoples, but them you set free;
text_cn: 你为栽培他们，曾亲手驱散外人， 你为发展他们，曾亲自磨难异民。

text_en: for not by their own sword did they win the land, nor did their own arm give them victory; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your countenance, for you delighted in them.
text_cn: 的确，他们占领了那地，并非靠着自己的刀剑， 他们获得了胜利，并非靠着自己的臂腕； 完全是赖着你的右手和你的腕能， 并你仪容的光辉，因为你喜爱他们。

text_en: You are my King and my God; you command victories for Jacob.
text_cn: 你是我的天主，我的君王， 是你使雅各伯打了胜仗。

text_en: Through you we push down our foes; through your name we tread down our assailants.
text_cn: 仰仗着你，我们克胜了我们的对头， 因你的名，我们践踏了我们的仇敌。

text_en: For not in my bow do I trust, nor can my sword save me.
text_cn: 因我从未依恃过我的弓箭， 拯救我的，也不是我的刀剑，

text_en: But you have saved us from our foes, and have put to confusion those who hate us.
text_cn: 而是你救我们脱离了我们的对头， 是你使痛恨我们的人都蒙羞受辱。

text_en: In God we have boasted continually, and we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah
text_cn: 我们时时以天主而自豪， 永永远远歌颂你的名号。 （休止）

text_en: Yet you have rejected us and abased us, and have not gone out with our armies.
text_cn: 然而现今你抛弃我们，使我们蒙羞受辱， 你也不再与我们的军队，一同出征为伍；

text_en: You made us turn back from the foe, and our enemies have gotten spoil.
text_cn: 反而使我们在敌人前，转身败走， 让那些憎恨我们的人，劫夺俘掳。

text_en: You have made us like sheep for slaughter, and have scattered us among the nations.
text_cn: 你使我们有如待宰的羔羊， 你使我们漂流而逃亡异邦；

text_en: You have sold your people for a trifle, demanding no high price for them.
text_cn: 你将你的子民贱价出售， 你由售价并未多获财富。

text_en: You have made us the taunt of our neighbors, the derision and scorn of those around us.
text_cn: 你使我们遭受邻邦的侮辱， 四周人民对我们讽刺咒诅；

text_en: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
text_cn: 你使我们成了异族的话柄， 外邦人都向我们摇头热讽。

text_en: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face
text_cn: 我的耻辱终日摆在我的眼前， 羞愧也常常笼罩着我的脸面：

text_en: at the words of the taunters and revilers, at the sight of the enemy and the avenger.
text_cn: 因我听到侮慢与欺凌者的声音， 又面临仇敌和寻隙报复的人民。

text_en: All this has come upon us, yet we have not forgotten you, or been false to your covenant.
text_cn: 我们虽然从未把你忘记过， 从来没有违背过你的盟约， 但我们身受了这一切灾祸。

text_en: Our heart has not turned back, nor have our steps departed from your way,
text_cn: 我们的心志从来没有萎靡退缩， 我们的脚步也未偏离你的正道；

text_en: yet you have broken us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with deep darkness.
text_cn: 但你竟将我们抛弃在野犬的边界， 以死亡的阴影把我们遮盖。

text_en: If we had forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
text_cn: 如果我们忘却了我们天主的圣名， 并举起我们的手朝向外邦的神明：

text_en: would not God discover this? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
text_cn: 难道天主究查不出这事？ 因为他洞悉人心的隐密。

text_en: Because of you we are being killed all day long, and accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
text_cn: 我们却是为了你，时常受伤受戕（qiāng）， 他们竟将我们视作待宰的群羊。

text_en: Rouse yourself! Why do you sleep, O Lord? Awake, do not cast us off forever!
text_cn: 醒来！我主，你为什么依旧沉睡？ 起来！你不要永远把我们抛弃。

text_en: Why do you hide your face? Why do you forget our affliction and oppression?
text_cn: 你为什么掩起你的慈颜， 不顾我们的痛苦和辛酸？

text_en: For we sink down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.
text_cn: 请看，我们的灵魂已俯伏在灰间， 我们的身体已紧贴于地面。

text_en: Rise up, come to our help. Redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love.
text_cn: 求你站起来，援助我们， 因你的慈爱，拯救我们。
